text: A backend may use equivalent flags/bitmaps/type walkers/proofs; omitted tracking shall require a sound proof at every read. Private metadata operations shall not be source events/races but shall be synchronized and inaccessible through source pointers. Missing metadata shall never imply an initialized value.
